method: Added harness preinit+instance-snapshot hook: harness_preinit() runs the reconstructed npmx_backend_init once (invoking run-stock npmx_core_init @0x55eb3f with restore_values=true over the modelled I2C), populating g2_npmx_instance @0x20070f78; that region (0x3900 bytes, through g2_npmx_backend/context) is snapshotted and restored before each variant run so both variants start from an identical populated instance. npmx_* library callees run as real stock code at recovered addresses. hal_i2c modelled as common stub. compareg canonicalizes stored function-pointer words (stock MRAM addr vs reconstructed ITCM addr of the same _XXXXXX function, from nm) so a pointer to an already-verified-equivalent sibling is not a false diff.

functions_verified.name: npmx_backend_init_511108
functions_verified.note: npmx_core_init + 8x core_event_interrupt_disable; stored i2c fn-pointers normalized

functions_verified.name: npmx_int_pin_configure_5111e6
functions_verified.note: gpio_get/gpio_mode_set; required correcting recovered gpio addresses (see note)

address_correction.finding: zip-recovered npmx map had npmx_gpio_get and npmx_gpio_mode_set SWAPPED. Disassembly of carved library region 0x55e000-0x560000 shows 0x55ee74 = getter (returns instance+40+idx*8) = npmx_gpio_get; 0x55ee7e = push{r7,lr};bl 0x55ee54(register-write helper) = npmx_gpio_mode_set.
address_correction.also_suspect: 0x55ee8c is a getter (instance+136+idx*4), NOT npmx_vbusin_task_trigger as the recovered map labels it; the recovered map needs a full disassembly audit before the remaining config/driver-init wrappers (application_configure, configure_buck2/lsdw1, watchdog_enable, main_driver_init) can be verified, since those call npmx_* currently mapped to placeholder 0x511003.
